query:
-- Cobranças pendentes do Francisco Claudio
SELECT id, client_name, value, status, type, description, due_date
FROM bpo_charges
WHERE client_name LIKE '%Francisco Claudio%'
  AND status IN ('pending', 'overdue', 'partiallyPaid')
ORDER BY due_date ASC
LIMIT 5;
